definitions.explanation: An organized event where members of a group (workplace, school, neighborhood, etc.) socialize to strengthen personal relationships. More structured than a casual party.

examples.japanese: {親睦会|しんぼくかい}に{参加|さんか}した。
{新入|しんにゅう}{社員|しゃいん}の{歓迎|かんげい}を{兼|か}ねた{親睦会|しんぼくかい}が{開|ひら}かれた。
examples.english: A social gathering was held that also served as a welcome event for new employees.

examples.japanese: {町内会|ちょうないかい}では{年|ねん}に{二回|にかい}、{親睦会|しんぼくかい}を{開催|かいさい}して{住民同士|じゅうみんどうし}の{交流|こうりゅう}を{深|ふか}めている。
examples.english: The neighborhood association holds social gatherings twice a year to deepen interaction among residents.

notes:
A compound of {親睦|しんぼく} (friendship, fellowship) and {会|かい} (meeting, gathering).

Common in Japanese workplace and community culture. These events often involve eating and drinking together. In a company context, they may be semi-mandatory — attending shows team spirit.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {懇親会|こんしんかい} is a near-synonym, slightly more formal
- {飲|の}み{会|かい} is a more casual drinking party
- {歓迎会|かんげいかい} specifically welcomes new members
- {送別会|そうべつかい} is a farewell party

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {親睦会|しんぼくかい}を{開|ひら}く (to hold a social gathering)
- {親睦会|しんぼくかい}に{出席|しゅっせき}する (to attend a social gathering)
- {親睦|しんぼく}を{深|ふか}める (to deepen fellowship)
